description.text:
Go karting in Central London just got better now that K1 Speed is open! Get ready for an adrenaline-pumping experience like never before!

Thrill-seekers, racing enthusiasts, and families alike, brace yourselves for the most exhilarating racing adventure you’ve ever encountered. With state-of-the-art electric go-karts, K1 Speed offers an eco-friendly and high-performance driving experience that will leave you breathless. Feel the rush of speed as you navigate through challenging twists and turns on our professionally designed indoor tracks, ensuring maximum excitement and safety for all.

Whether you’re a seasoned racer or a first-time driver, K1 Speed caters to all skill levels. Our cutting-edge timing system accurately measures your lap times, allowing you to compete against friends and family or challenge your personal best. Want to take it to the next level? Join our competitive leagues and unleash your inner racer as you vie for victory and claim the title of the fastest driver in London.

Be prepared to make unforgettable memories with your loved ones or colleagues, as K1 Speed is the ideal venue for birthday parties, corporate events, team building, and group gatherings.

Get your heart racing at K1 Speed Canary Wharf in Central London! Experience the ultimate racing adventure that will leave you craving for more.
